jobs.list.title: List jobs
jobs.list.description: List public job postings via GET /v1/boards/{boardToken}/jobs.

jobs.get.title: Get job
jobs.get.description: Fetch a single Harvest job via authenticated GET /v3/jobs/{id}. Distinct from boards jobs.list.

candidates.list.title: List candidates
candidates.list.description: List candidates via authenticated Harvest GET /v3/candidates. Optional perPage, page, createdBefore/After, updatedBefore/After, jobId, email, and candidateIds filters.

candidates.get.title: Get candidate
candidates.get.description: Fetch a single candidate via authenticated Harvest GET /v3/candidates/{id}.

applications.list.title: List applications
applications.list.description: List applications via authenticated Harvest GET /v3/applications. Optional perPage, page, createdBefore/After, lastActivityAfter, jobId, and status filters.

applications.get.title: Get application
applications.get.description: Fetch a single application via authenticated Harvest GET /v3/applications/{id}.

applications.move.title: Move application
applications.move.description: Move an application to another interview stage (or transfer to another job) via authenticated Harvest POST /v3/applications/{id}/move. Requires fromStageId matching the current stage. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes the post-move application via applications.get (move itself returns 204).

fromStageId.description: Current job interview stage id; must match the application's current stage.

toStageId.description: Destination stage id within the same job.

toJobId.description: Destination job id when transferring the application to another job.

emailFromUserId.description: Optional user id used as the from address for stage-transition emails.

application.description: Normalized application after reconcile via applications.get.

applications.create.title: Create application
applications.create.description: Create an application for an existing candidate via authenticated Harvest POST /v3/applications. Requires candidateId and jobId. EffectPolicy Idempotent observes the created application via applications.get.

candidateId.description: Harvest candidate id to attach the application to.

jobId.description: Harvest job id for the candidate application.

initialStageId.description: Optional job interview stage id to place the application in.

sourceId.description: Optional source id credited for this application.

application.description: Normalized application after reconcile via applications.get.

users.list.title: List users
users.list.description: List users via authenticated Harvest GET /v3/users. Optional perPage, page, email, employeeId, and created/updated before/after filters.

interviews.list.title: List interviews
interviews.list.description: List interviews via authenticated Harvest GET /v3/interviews (v1: scheduled_interviews). Optional perPage, page, applicationId, jobId, and created/updated before/after filters.

job_interview_stages.list.title: List job interview stages
job_interview_stages.list.description: List job interview stages via authenticated Harvest GET /v3/job_interview_stages. Optional perPage, jobIds, ids, and active filters. Supports move-stage workflows.

healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Validate Greenhouse Harvest credentials with GET /users?per_page=1.
